# Demographic

This folder covers the demographic characteristics of patients recorded in the Danish Acute Surgery Database (AKDB). It details the age distribution of individuals undergoing acute surgery in Denmark, specifically highlighting that the average patient age is approximately 65 years while the median age is around 70 years for the 2022–2023 period. These statistics provide essential context for understanding the population burden and clinical risk profiles associated with emergency surgical interventions.

## Pages

- [[demographic|Demographic]] — Details the age distribution of acute surgery patients in Denmark, highlighting an average age of 65 and a median age of 70.
